transcript: Your body is aging twice as fast as it should, and stress is the reason why. If you wake up tired after sleeping, if your head feels heavy, if memories slip away more easily than before, this is not just stress, this is a quiet fire within you. Stress, when it visits briefly, can sharpen the mind, but when it stays, it begins to consume the one who carries it. Your body releases cortisol to protect you from danger, but you live in it as if danger never ends, and so the body forgets how to rest. The heart works harder than it should, the mind becomes clouded, the stomach tightens like a knot that does not release. Even the part of your brain that holds memory begins to shrink in silence. This is why you feel scattered, why focus escapes you, and still you continue. But understand this, the body is not your enemy, it is your messenger. What you call stress is often a life that has drifted too far from stillness. If you do not calm the storm, the storm will become your nature, and the most dangerous part, stress feeds itself. A restless mind creates a restless body, and a restless body creates a restless mind. So if you feel this, do not ignore it. I created a 30 day healing journey to help you return to stillness, step by step. Quiet the mind, calm the body, and rebuild your energy from within. It is simple, but it is powerful. If you are ready, the path is waiting for you in the link on my profile.
